intro: Lesson 99: Revision: Physics 3 waves and the electromagnetic spectrum. Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: Ultraviolet and infrared both come from the Sun. Compare their properties, uses and dangers. Portal response box.
questions.a: Both transverse EM waves at the same speed (1); UV higher frequency, shorter wavelength (1); UV use: security marking, sterilising (1); IR use: heating, remote controls (1); UV danger: skin cancer, eye damage (1); IR danger: burns (1).
questions.model: Teacher writes the similarity first: 'Both are electromagnetic waves, transverse, travelling at 3 × 10⁸ m/s in a vacuum.'

questions.q: A water wave travels 12 m in 4 s; its wavelength is 1.5 m. Find its frequency.
Explain how people protect themselves from gamma radiation in hospitals.
questions.a: Lead or concrete shielding (1); limit exposure time and keep distance (1).

questions.q: A wave has period 0.02 s. Frequency?
Give one difference between transverse and longitudinal waves.
questions.a: Transverse oscillations are at right angles to energy transfer; longitudinal are parallel.

questions.q: State one use and one danger of X-rays.
questions.a: Medical imaging of bones (1); can damage cells and cause cancer (1).

questions.q: Big question: what do radio, light and X-rays have in common?
questions.a: All are transverse EM waves travelling at the speed of light in a vacuum; they differ in wavelength and frequency.
